messages:
marta: Quick ask — need a benchmark hero + 3 social tiles for the webinar launch next Tue. Also need a slide template and an accessibility/brand compliance sweep. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/launch-pack :rocket:
senior-design: Got it. Can you confirm copy for each tile and sizes? Preferred exports: social hero 1200x628, square tile 1080x1080, slide hero 1920x1080. Also need ALT text for each image for accessibility checks.
sam: I'll drop the final benchmark numbers here by EOD — main callout should be a latency vs cost sparkline plus a short stat like "~X% lower cost". Keep copy short for tiles.
elliot: +1 on ALT and contrast. Brandbot: automated check flagged primary blue #0A58FF for text on white at 12px — fails WCAG AA. Recommend either darken the blue or increase text size/weight.
senior-design: I'll iterate color variants. Quick question on logo lockups — can we use the stacked logo inside the square tiles? The guidelines usually prefer horizontal on wide assets. @marta for sign-off.
marta: Stacked is ok for square tiles but follow the safe zone: at least 8px clear space, no drop shadow, and don't place logo over busy parts of the image. Avoid heavy gradients underneath the logo.
katie: Also need a slide template with placeholders for speaker name, title, 3 key takeaways, and a footer line for legal copy. For inbound routing: add UTM campaign=webinar_apr and instruct sales to tag leads with source: "webinar-bench" in the CRM.
senior-design: Will deliver Figma components + export presets. Exports snippet for handoff:
```
Social hero: 1200x628 @2x PNG
Square tile: 1080x1080 @2x PNG
Slide hero: 1920x1080 PDF (press quality)
Diagrams: SVG + 1x PNG fallback
All images: include alt text in the figma description field
```
elliot: Timeline check?
senior-design: Draft visuals by Fri EOD, updated variants for contrast by Mon morning. Final exports by Mon noon so content can be queued.
sam: I'll need the final visual comps no later than Mon 2pm to assemble the post copy and benchmark appendix.
katie: Legal — claims like "X% cost reduction" require the benchmark appendix. I'll review once numbers are in. No other compliance blockers for creative as long as we include the appendix link on long-form assets.
marta: Awesome — final asks: label frames in Figma as marketing/social/hero, marketing/social/square, marketing/slide/hero; add copy placeholders and alt copy; flag any color variants with notes. I'll post the publishing schedule in #marketing tomorrow. Thanks everyone :tada:"
